title: Opening protectives.
officialText:
Openings in hoistway enclosures shall be protected as required in Chapter 7.
Exception: The elevator car doors and the associated hoistway enclosure doors at the floor level designated for recall in
accordance with Section 3003.2 shall be permitted to remain open during Phase I Emergency Recall Operation in
accordance with ASME A17.1, as modified by Appendix K, Chapter K1.
